phase: Phase 4 reported baseline (prior to Phase 4.1 enhancements)

identified_flaws.description: Lateral movement multi-hop probe sequences whose intermediate hops connected adjacent graph nodes were omitted from unexpected edge clustering, resulting in misclassification as isolated denials.

identified_flaws.category: Approval ID Hash Collision in Synthetic Generator
identified_flaws.description: Synthetic generator used narrow random range randint(10000, 99999), causing duplicate approval IDs across 10,000 events which overwrote earlier subject registrations and triggered subject-mismatch false positives.

identified_flaws.category: Unbound Session State Across Different Actors
identified_flaws.description: Session tracking keyed purely on session_id without actor binding, allowing two distinct actors sharing an identical random session token to inherit unapproved role elevation taint.
